decisive_items: a 104 × 102 × 141 mm mediastino-pulmonary mass in the left upper lobe
an endobronchial lesion in the left upper-lobe bronchus
response.rationale: The presence of a large mediastino-pulmonary mass and an endobronchial lesion in the left upper lobe bronchus more strongly suggests lung cancer than lymphoma or metastatic disease.

rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence for metastatic disease
